resources.string: Reference photo (e.g. the coffee machine or the fridge)
The alarm rings on the chosen days, even when the phone is locked. It only stops once the tasks are done and you have taken a photo of the same spot as the reference photo.
Take a reference photo, then set the alarm.
Test alarm in 1 minute. Feel free to lock the phone.
Allow full-screen notifications for Op Med Dig, then try again
Wrong. Here is a new one.
Go to the spot in the reference photo and take a picture
That doesn\'t look like the reference photo (%1$d %%). Go there and try again.
Good morning! You\'re out of bed.
Tap to turn off the alarm
Go through the list once. Items with a button need fixing, otherwise the alarm can\'t ring properly.
The alarm uses a notification to wake the screen.
Without it, the alarm screen won\'t appear when the phone is locked.
Many phones (especially Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus and Huawei) close apps to save power. Then the alarm may not ring in the morning.
The app turns the alarm volume all the way up and locks it while ringing. It works in silent mode too, but not if the phone is off or out of battery. Charge it overnight.

Photograph something fixed and easy to recognise, like the coffee machine or the fridge. Avoid places that look very different with the lights on and off. Take the photo in the same light as in the morning.
Tap \"Test the alarm in 1 minute\", lock the phone and wait. Check that it rings and that the photo is accepted.

The alarm only stops when the tasks are done and the photo is accepted. After the tasks the volume drops to 50 %. The back button and volume buttons do nothing on the alarm screen. Locking the phone is fine. Turning the phone off or uninstalling the app will of course stop it.
The app is not from the Play Store. Play Protect may warn you during install, choose \"Install anyway\". New versions are installed manually on top of the old one.
Lets the app install new versions from GitHub itself. On Android 12 and newer it then updates on its own; otherwise you get an Update button.
New version of Op Med Dig
Allow Op Med Dig to install updates, then tap again
